outcome: postpartum depression (PPD) risk at one month postpartum (EPDS score >= 9)
cohort: The study included 6681 women who delivered full-term singleton babies between January 2012 and August 2021 at a university hospital in Japan.
finding: Attending a two-week postpartum health checkup was associated with a significantly lower prevalence of postpartum depression risk at one month postpartum.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a lower risk of an EPDS score >= 9 at one month postpartum.
